_meta.description: Rock colours for the tfc-1.20 profile's rock raster layer and legend. This is our own UI design choice, not a port of any Java source: colours follow the real-world look of each rock family so the map reads geologically — dark greys/greens for mafic volcanics and plutonics (basalt, gabbro), warm pinks/tans for felsic plutonics and rhyolite (granite, diorite, dacite, rhyolite), pale buffs and creams for carbonate/clastic sedimentaries (chalk, limestone, dolomite, marble), warm browns for clastic sedimentaries (claystone, conglomerate, chert), and blue-grey/olive tones for the foliated metamorphics (slate, phyllite, schist, gneiss, quartzite). Every id here is ported game data from src/data/tfc-1.20/rocks.json (net.dries007.tfc.world.settings.RockLayerSettings's rock registration, see src/worldgen/tfc-1.20/rock/layer-settings.ts) — only the colour assigned to each id is a design decision. Packed as 0xRRGGBB decimal, matching src/render/colormap.ts's colorToCss.
